column1: # Golden defaults (#440, epic #437): the effective default of every config key
# the call sites relied on, taken from main at c086a81 BEFORE any call site was
# migrated to the table in scripts/pipeline-defaults.sh.
# One row per key, four TAB-separated columns:
#   key     the config key ("agents.roles.developer.*" stands for any role)
#   golden  the value a lookup printed on main when no config layer set the key:
#           the literal the call sites passed, or the playbook/README default
#           for a key no script reads. A newline is the two characters \n.
#   kind    table     the table default must equal golden, exactly
#           empty     golden is empty: the key is derived or has no default
#           explicit  the call site keeps passing its own value on purpose
#                     the test pins that behaviour, not a table row
#           equiv     the table differs from the old literal but every
#                     consumer treats both alike (checked in the test)
#   sites   where main read the key ("docs" = no script reads it)
# tests/test-config-golden-defaults.sh checks every non-empty table default
# against this list, so a wrong table row goes red before it can change
# behaviour. Do not edit a golden value to make that test pass: a golden value
# only changes when the documented default changes.
